Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma. Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible). Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala). Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes. Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP. Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto. Inglês fluente.Diferenciais Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse. Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade. Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.Formação e Experiência Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on). Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

Compute Engine Mastery:Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling. English Proficiency:Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have PostgreSQL Expertise:Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning. Data & Analytics:Familiarity withBigQuery.We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Senior Cloud Engineer

Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.Position Overview:We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.What You'll Do:Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction. Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions. Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture. Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more. Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform. Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline. Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients. Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use. Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.What We're Looking For:Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment. At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer. Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security. Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices. Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices. Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services. Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows. Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP). Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Fluency in English, both written and verbal. Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools. Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.Bonus Points For:Certifications in more than one cloud provider FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools. Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services. Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews. Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices. Experience in a technology consulting environment. Experience with multiple cloud platforms.What We Offer:Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement. Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. description: ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimentoSOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.Conheça mais em:  agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not "does it run" - "what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants." Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training. Tech-Savvy– Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms. Cold call and email Director and above level executives to secure meetings and demos. Team Coordination Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs. Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team's success. Meeting attendance rate. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours/week. Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET. Open to applicants based in LATAM. What We Offer Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split). SPIFFs and performance incentives. Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.P.S. title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month

Resume:

English version only.

Highlight SAAS projects, healthcare related projects, and HIPAA experience.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps. You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.G., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.G., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.G., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.G., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.Desired Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.This role starts at R$10,000 per month

Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.

Integridade : Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.

Estamos procurando profissionais dinâmicos e proativos, com uma atitude positiva e habilidades em negócios e sistemas para trabalho em equipe. Valorizamos paciência, comprometimento e a capacidade de lidar bem com usuários e clientes.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.

E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?

Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional.
  • Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual)
  • Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância.
  • Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados.
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.

Requisitos necessários

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância.
  • Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual).
  • Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank.
  • Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
  • Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes.
  • Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery.
  • Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.

Perfil esperado

  • Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário.
  • Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto.
  • Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
  • Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Loyalty Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer Iii
description:
Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.

O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.

Qualificações Mínimas

- Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

- Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

- Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

- Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

- Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

- Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

- Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

- Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

- Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

- Inglês fluente.

Qualificações Desejáveis

- Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

- Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.

- Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).

- Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

- Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

- Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

É esperado que você combine a disciplina da gestão clássica de projetos com práticas ágeis modernas, dominando ferramentas e metodologias de ponta.Requisitos: Roadmap integrado com priorizações, desdobramentos e marcos. Plano de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders (matriz RACI, mapeamento de impacto). Métricas de sucesso do projeto e controle de entregas por squad ou frente. Cronograma de capacitação e readiness (documentação, UAT, suporte de pós-go live). Acompanhamento estruturado por metodologia híbrida (ágil + tradicional). Planejamento e execução de Sprint 0 e fases Discovery, se aplicável. Liderança: Capacidade de coordenar múltiplos times e níveis organizacionais com clareza, empatia e foco em resultado. Comunicação executiva: Consegue transitar bem entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, ajustando linguagem e reportes. Visão de produto e entrega: Compreende o ciclo completo de soluções de dados – da engenharia à aplicação no negócio. Autonomia e ownership: Alta capacidade de autogestão, priorização e tomada de decisão em ambientes ambíguos. Conhecimentos desejáveis Governança de dados (DAMA, LGPD, catálogos, data quality, linhagem). Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase. Ferramentas de gestão de projetos: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project. Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e tradicionais (PMBOK, PRINCE2). Conhecimento em produtos de dados, data mesh e arquiteturas modernas (data lake, cloud, event-driven). Storytelling com dados: saber transformar indicadores e métricas em narrativas acionáveis. Inglês fluente (Necessário para comunicação).O que você fará no seu dia a dia? Atuar como liderança técnica e referência na visão de cliente e negócio, fortalecendo o relacionamento com stakeholders internos e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time. Ter forte orientação a negócio, compreendendo operações, métricas e processos para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o atingimento de metas. Disseminar conhecimento por meio de documentação clara e comunicação efetiva entre pares e áreas. Demonstrar atitude de dono, aplicando boas práticas em processos, tecnologias e entregas, com foco em resultados. Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia, conduzindo escopos de curto, médio e longo prazo com comunicação clara e assertiva. Gerenciar projetos e programas de dados com múltiplas squads e alto nível de complexidade técnica e funcional. Planejar e acompanhar roadmaps, cronogramas e marcos, garantindo previsibilidade das entregas. Garantir business readiness, coordenando comunicação, treinamentos, documentação e alinhamentos necessários. Facilitar rituais ágeis quando aplicável (Planning, Review, Retrospective). Orquestrar dependências entre times de dados, produtos, arquitetura e governança. Estabelecer rotinas de comunicação e reportes com stakeholders, acompanhando indicadores e progresso. Organizar entregáveis finais como go-live, guias operacionais, planos de suporte e trilhas de capacitação.Local de atuação:No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

description:

Development of policiesgoverning margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring;

Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years)in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstratedindependence from commercial functionsand ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of.Please email the video towith the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

Experiência com React: Conhecimento profundo em Hooks, Context API e gerenciamento de estado. Node.Js: Experiência no desenvolvimento de serviços escaláveis e integração com bancos de dados. Versionamento: Domínio de Git e fluxos de trabalho (Gitflow). Perfil Resolutivo: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas e propor soluções técnicas eficazes. Presencial: Disponibilidade para reuniões e trabalho presencial em Florianópolis (3x/semana na ACATE Primavera)Desejável:Experiência com Next.Js ou NestJS. Conhecimento em bancos de dados (Firestore, PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou MySQL). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e containers (Docker). Noções de infraestrutura (AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure).

title: Analytics Engineer - Sênior
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesGarante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos e resilientes;
Atua na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;

title: Redator
description: Procurando alguém para criar um site sobre séries!Estou desenvolvendo a ideia de um site totalmente dedicado a séries — com críticas, recomendações, notícias, listas temáticas e análises de episódios.Busco alguém interessado em participar da criação do projeto, seja na parte de desenvolvimento, design ou conteúdo. A ideia é construir algo moderno, organizado e com potencial de crescimento.Se você curte séries e tem interesse em fazer parte desse projeto (como parceria ou trabalho remunerado, a combinar), me chama no direct para conversarmos melhor!Vamos criar algo incrível juntos?Descrição da Empresa Clube Séries é uma comunidade apaixonada pelo universo dos seriados, dedicada a trazer informações atuais e relevantes sobre o mundo do entretenimento. Atuamos como uma plataforma colaborativa, conectando fãs de séries e criando conteúdo de alta qualidade para artigos, notícias e resenhas. Nosso objetivo é informar e entreter nosso público, promovendo discussões e reflexões sobre as novidades e tendências da televisão e do streaming. Nossa equipe valoriza a criatividade, a dedicação e a paixão pela escrita. Descrição do Cargo O Redator de Notícias será responsável por escrever e publicar artigos informativos sobre o universo das séries, incluindo análises, comentários e comunicados de imprensa. As atividades diárias incluem pesquisa de temas relevantes, redação e revisão de textos e colaboração com outros membros da equipe para garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos editoriais. Este é um cargo voluntário com flexibilidade para trabalho remoto. Qualificações Redação de Notícias e Releases: Experiência em escrever notícias e comunicados de imprensa com clareza, concisão e precisão. Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de transmitir informações de forma eficaz por meio da escrita e colaborar com a equipe de forma clara e produtiva. Jornalismo e Escrita: Conhecimento e prática em técnicas de jornalismo e habilidade para produzir conteúdo de qualidade que capte a atenção dos leitores. Será um diferencial ter conhecimento em tendências de entretenimento e séries de TV, bem como habilidades em SEO para otimizar o alcance do conteúdo online.Descrição da EmpresaClube Séries é uma plataforma dedicada aos apaixonados por séries de TV, trazendo conteúdos relevantes e diversificados sobre o universo dos seriados. Nosso objetivo é conectar fãs e compartilhar as últimas novidades por meio de resenhas, análises e notícias exclusivas. Com uma equipe dinâmica e apaixonada, buscamos inspirar e engajar nossa audiência no Brasil e além. Descrição do CargoEstamos à procura de uma pessoa criativa e comprometida para atuar como redator, editor e social mídia em nosso time. As principais responsabilidades incluem criação e edição de conteúdos, gestão das redes sociais, planejamento de publicações e interação com a comunidade de seguidores. Esta é uma oportunidade de ser voluntário e ganhar experiência no setor, com a vantagem de trabalhar remotamente. Qualificações Produção e Edição de Conteúdo:Experiência ou interesse em produzir e editar textos envolventes para artigos, resenhas e conteúdos relacionados a séries e entretenimento. Gestão de Redes Sociais:Conhecimento sobre plataformas sociais, como Instagram, Twitter e Facebook. Habilidade em planejar publicações, interagir com seguidores e monitorar engajamento. Comunicação:Capacidade de escrita criativa e clara, acompanhada de habilidade para adaptar o tom de voz de acordo com a audiência. É desejável que a pessoa tenha familiaridade com ferramentas de design para criar conteúdos visuais, além de estar atualizada com tendências no universo de séries e mídias digitais.

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&LAbout the Role: We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.Responsibilities: Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance. Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies. Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions. Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently. Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks. Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows. Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.Requirements: Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting. Experience working with browser extensions and online tools. Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required). Strong analytical and critical thinking skills. High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively. Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis. Good written communication skills in English.Nice to Have: Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work. Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments. Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise. Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment. Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details: Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum. Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave). Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.Application Process: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge. Once the assessment is cleared, you're ready to start contributing!After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Analista De Implantação Erp - Módulo Supply Chain
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Disponibilidade para viagens;

Familiaridade com PDVs e arquivos de cupons fiscais;

Visão analítica para apresentação de relatórios de BI com o objetivo de atender às necessidades do cliente;
Resiliência e capacidade de autoaprendizagem.

title: Cientista De Dados | Prevenção A Fraude (Foco Em Ia)
description: Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados que una o rigor estatístico à agilidade das novas tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial. Aqui, você será a peça-chave para identificar padrões ocultos e construir sistemas de defesa inteligentes que garantam a segurança do nosso ecossistema de forma escalável e inovadora.Como será o seu dia a dia Modelagem e Antecipação:Desenvolver e implementar modelos de Machine Learning e algoritmos estatísticos para detectar, identificar e, principalmente,anteciparpadrões de fraude. IA no Estado da Arte:Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de IA e técnicas de análise de dados para otimizar a precisão das defesas e a escalabilidade dos processos. Visão Estratégica:Transformar grandes volumes de dados em insights acionáveis, propondo soluções que equilibrem segurança e experiência do usuário. Colaboração Ativa:Atuar em parceria com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para garantir que os modelos estejam perfeitamente integrados à nossa plataforma. Mentoria e Cultura:Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico de membros Júniores e Plenos, promovendo um ambiente de troca de conhecimento e inovação contínua. MLOps e Ciclo de Vida do Modelo:Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps — Monitorar continuamente os modelos em produção, identificando degradações de performance, drift de dados e necessidade de re-treino.O que buscamos (Requisitos Técnicos) Base Estatística Sólida:Domínio de conceitos estatísticos aplicados à modelagem e análise de comportamento. Domínio de Programação:Experiência avançada emPythoneSQL(R é um diferencial). Toolkit de IA:Experiência prática com frameworks de Machine Learning e abertura/entusiasmo para utilizar novas ferramentas deIA (GenAI, Auto ML, etc.)para otimização de fluxos. Cloud e Big Data:Vivência em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmenteAWS ) e manipulação de grandes datasets. Agilidade:Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e capacidade de entrega em ciclos rápidos. Formação:Graduação ou pós-graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas.Perfil Comportamental (O que nos brilha o olho) Comunicação Excepcional:Capacidade de traduzir termos técnicos complexos para stakeholders de diferentes áreas e níveis de liderança. Mentalidade Colaborativa (Team First):Valorizamos quem joga para o time. Buscamos profissionais que saibam pedir e oferecer ajuda, sem resistências ao trabalho em grupo. Mindset de Inovação:Curiosidade para testar novas ferramentas e questionar o\ "status quo\" dos processos de prevenção. Resiliência e Flexibilidade:Capacidade de se adaptar a mudanças de cenário e novos padrões de fraude com agilidade. Sensibilidade ao Falso Positivo:Consciência do impacto do falso positivo — saber que um bloqueio indevido tem custo real para o usuário legítimo e para o negócio.Por que vir para cá? Ambiente de comunicação aberta e horizontal. Oportunidade de atuar com tecnologias de ponta em um problema real e de alto impacto. Foco real em desenvolvimento contínuo e bem-estar do time.

You will be designing landing pages and blog pages using our existing design system, applying taste and judgment along the way A real, demonstrable AI-powered workflow. You use AI tools daily and have opinions about which ones are worth the time. We will ask for specifics in the interview Solid fundamentals in HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript Fast, energetic, and naturally curious. You move quickly without being sloppy Coachable. You will be working closely with the team and with leadershipNice to have Experience applying SEO best practices on Webflow sites Comfort with custom code in Webflow (embeds, interactions, CMS work) Familiarity with Figma and modern design workflows Background in marketing, growth, or agency environmentsWhy Tecla Direct exposure to Tecla's leadership and the Growth team. title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing: Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview: We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements: Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German) Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details: Engagement type :Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_AngelesKnow amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Job type: Full-time employee

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsável pelo atendimento especializado a crianças e adolescentes com distúrbios neurológicos, atuando no diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de condições que afetam o desenvolvimento do sistema nervoso central e periférico. Atua em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a reabilitação e melhoria da qualidade de vida dos pacientes.

  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento neurológico dos pacientes, realizando avaliações periódicas.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com psicólogos, fonoaudiólogos, terapeutas ocupacionais, fisioterapeutas e demais profissionais.
  • Orientar familiares sobre diagnósticos, tratamentos e prognósticos.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, discussões de caso e programas de educação continuada.

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria.

Residência ou especialização em Neurologia Pediátrica.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe.

Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ

title: Cfd Consultant, Lead
description:
Lead CFD & Process Safety Consultant

The Lead CFD & Process Safety Consultant will successfully deliver projects for clients as a member of project teams within a market program. This includes supporting the project manager by leading teams initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, controlling deliver high-impact technical projects across Brazil and global markets, supporting clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across CAPEX and OPEX projects, supporting customers in upstream, midstream, downstream, and emerging sectors such as BESS, CCS, and hydrogen doing advanced technical analysis, practical risk-based engineering judgment, direct client engagement and leadership in project delivery.

What You Will Do

The Lead manages small teams to work on project tasks under the supervision of a project manager to ensure quality services are delivered on schedule and within the available budget to meet customer requirements.

  • Assist the project manager with defining and sequencing project tasks, estimating task duration, and developing a project schedule as part of developing a project management plan.
  • Fire and explosion modelling.
  • Gas detector allocation.
  • Flame detector allocation.
  • Exhaust and ventilation dispersion.
  • Smoke and gas dispersion.
  • Flare radiation analysis.
  • Helideck turbulence studies.
  • Process safety and risk studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow-Tie, Safety Case, and EERA.
  • Review project management plans to understand the scope, schedule, and assigned work authorization.
  • Planning and scheduling client meetings
  • Lead client and tasks-team meetings
  • Lead small task teams with the execution of project tasks.
  • Assist with research and data analysis, including but not limited to assisting with conducting customer or stakeholder analyses.
  • Prepare written documents, reports, and presentations.
  • Develop conclusions and recommendations, write reports, and assist with client presentations.
  • Give oral presentations to clients.
  • Tracking and reporting hours spent executing projects.
  • Work with individuals at all levels, provide input to reports and other deliverables, execute multiple assignments, meet agreed deadlines, and adjust to changing client demands.
  • Performing quality assurance on project deliverables
  • Develop relationships with existing customers to facilitate the development of new business.
  • Identify new business opportunities with existing customers for current and/or additional services.
What You Will Need
  • 2-4 years of professional experience is the minimum required.
  • Degree in Engineering, preferably Chemical or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Strong experience in advanced CFD modelling applied to risk and safety.
  • Experience in analyses related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection studies.
  • Fluent Portuguese and English.
  • Strong report writing, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and deliver high-quality technical work in a consulting environment.
  • FLACS.
  • KFX.
  • Ansys Fluent.
  • Ansys CFX.
  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Safety Engineering, Process Safety, or related field.
  • Experience in QRA, vulnerability analysis, PHAST, and/or SAFETI.
  • Knowledge of Human Factors, including:
    • Human Reliability Analysis (HRA)
    • Human Factors Engineering (HFE)
  • Familiarity with Petro-HRA.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian regulations and industry requirements, including Petrobras guidelines, ANP requirements, and applicable NRs.
  • Experience across upstream, downstream, and midstream.
  • Knowledge of Python, VBA, or other programming/automation tools.
  • Interest in digitalization and technical innovation.
  • Spanish language skills desirable.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Delegation skills.
  • Strong written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Perform research and provide analysis on research performed.
  • Gather and analyze data effectively.
  • Apply critical thinking to a wide variety of problems.
  • Comprehend and analyze complex problems.
  • Work under tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, safety, quality, and environmental management systems.
Reporting Relationships

Could report to the Project Manager or Program Manager or a more senior level Consultant.

A Ortobom iniciou suas atividades em 1969, fabricando camas e mesas de metal. Atenta às novas tendências, a empresa passou a comprar blocos de espuma para a confecção de colchões, que harmoniosamente se casavam com as camas.

Em 1975, a Ortobom inaugurou no Rio de Janeiro a primeira fábrica especializada na fabricação de colchões. O objetivo era a produção e comercialização de colchões que proporcionassem o máximo de bem-estar e conforto aos clientes.

O sonho virou realidade. Hoje a Ortobom possui 12 fábricas e 400.000 m2 de área construída. São mais de 2.000 lojas no Brasil, com filiais também na Bolívia, Uruguai e Paraguai. O setor fabril, se somado, tem uma área superior a de grandes montadoras de automóveis.

A Ortobom é a maior produtora de colchões da América Latina e a 2ª maior produtora de espuma do mundo.

A qualidade é garantida através de um investimento constante em tecnologia, desde a matéria-prima ao maquinário. Toda essa estrutura só é possível graças ao potencial humano: são mais de 6.000 colaboradores, 1.000 franqueados e 5.000 consultores em todo o Brasil.

Associate Solutions Architect – TestBox

Remote — Must be based in Rio de Janeiro or Niterói

$36,000 USD / year + equity & benefits

About TestBox

TestBox was founded with a bold mission : to fundamentally transform how software is bought and sold. We're building an innovative platform that empowers buyers with transparent, interactive software experiences, while equipping sellers with powerful tools to deliver exceptional buying and onboarding journeys. Our core technologies—synthetic data, intelligent orchestration, and our unique product graph—help teams achieve faster implementations, clearer insights, and increase trust with their customers.

At TestBox, we're not just improving demos; we're building the next generation infrastructure for software transactions, creating seamless experiences from initial interest to successful onboarding and beyond.

We're a fast-growing startup built by a team that values experimentation, velocity, and customer impact. We're backed by world-class investors and are building a platform that's disrupting the traditional B2B sales motion.

Role Overview

As a Solutions Architect at TestBox, you'll be at the heart of our customer experience—designing, building, and delivering high-impact demo and POC environments that drive sales success for our customers.

You’ll lead technical delivery, participate in agile rituals like standups and retros, and act as a trusted consultant to help customers design stories that resonate. You’ll also be expected to innovate and move fast—this isn't a role for someone looking to just “follow the playbook.”

To succeed here, you’ll need to be curious, flexible, and scrappy. You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams, and you’ll use AI tools (including our own) daily to boost your productivity, generate data, and solve complex problems creatively.

Key Responsibilities

Project Ownership & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of customer demo and POC environments—from kickoff through delivery.
  • Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, and retros; communicate blockers and drive timelines forward.
  • Collaborate across customer engineering, solutions, and product teams to ensure smooth handoffs and clear technical execution.

Customer Storytelling & Consulting

  • Help customers craft compelling demo narratives grounded in real-world buyer personas, workflows, and industry context.
  • Design fictional yet realistic companies and user journeys to simulate how the product solves specific problems.
  • Advise on best practices for demo structure, content pacing, and emotional resonance.

Environment Implementation

  • Configure CRM, support, or comms tools with customized fields, workflows, and industry templates.
  • Simulate real user behavior using automation, time-based triggers, and behavioral scripting. (We integrate AI-powered interactions where relevant to enhance realism)

AI-Driven Efficiency

  • Leverage AI tools (including LLMs like OpenAI and Anthropic, automation platforms) to speed up data generation, ticket writing, and documentation.
  • Continuously explore ways to innovate and disrupt traditional workflows using AI—TestBox is built on this mindset.

Documentation & Ticket Writing

  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.

Who You Are

  • You're fluent in english.
  • You're resourceful, autonomous, and outcomes-driven —comfortable leading projects with limited structure.
  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.
  • Experience working in agile environments (standups, retros, ticket grooming, etc.).
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, text‑to‑speech engines, automation platforms) to drive efficiency, draft technical documentation, create demo content, or solve complex problems.
  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.

Why Join TestBox

  • Shape the future of how software is bought and sold.
  • Build with a team that values autonomy, curiosity, and experimentation.
  • Use AI every day—not as a gimmick, but as a core productivity engine.
  • Make a direct impact in a high-growth startup redefining the demo experience.

Benefits
